tasks.short: Distribute assembly materials to work areas

steps.what: Find materials and destination work areas on the current job list
Check material identity, quantities and handling condition
Move supplies and subassemblies safely to the work areas
Hand the delivered materials to the receiving assembly colleague

tasks.design: Configure a released-job picking view in {ERP} so the assembler finds material and destination together. Physical checking, movement and handover remain with people; this design adds no delivery log.
tasks.previous_blocker: Material and destination could require separate job-screen lookups.
tasks.enabler_now: A native job view can place existing fields together.
tasks.still_hard: Fragile parts, congestion and missing components need local judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The assembler verifies and handles the actual load.
tasks.altitude: Spend less time navigating job screens while preserving safe handling.

reach.learn: Which work-area labels confuse material runners

evidence.claim: Variant-specific shop-floor instructions can be built from MRP jobs; this supports job-context availability, not automated material transport.
The picking-view time estimate is an unmeasured local scenario.

assumptions: Boundary includes finding, checking, moving and handing over material. No extra distribution record is assumed today.

The production planner produces released job, material identifiers and destination before distribution as part of existing job release. The assembler's s1 includes finding and validating that reference; missing or stale fields require the original manual lookup with no saving.
Native ERP views come first. Three hours per 100 baseline hours are removed from s1 by avoiding a separate destination lookup; identity and quantity checks are unchanged.
No new monitoring or maintenance labour is proposed beyond ordinary view administration; incremental upkeep is set to zero for this small native view.
unknowns: Whether the existing job screen already combines material and destination
research_questions: Does a timed sample show a separate destination lookup in otherwise comparable material runs?

already_counted.description: Assembler validates job context and handles incomplete picking information in s1.

incremental.description: No separate ongoing activity is added by the native view.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100, R=97, gross and net saving 3 with zero incremental upkeep. Low 0 if the current view already shows destinations, retaining all 15 lookup hours. High 2 retains 13 lookup hours where only some destinations are reliable, plus all 85 physical and handover hours. Central case retains 12 lookup hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain production, time and component waste reports

steps.what: Capture production counts, job times and component waste reasons at the station
outputs: dated station entries with job identifiers and waste reasons

steps.what: Calculate production, time and component waste report totals
inputs: dated station entries with job identifiers and waste reasons
outputs: draft report totals with source entries

steps.what: Review report totals against station entries and resolve discrepancies
inputs: draft report totals with source entries

steps.what: Complete the report explanation using the checked values
Check the final report version and send it to the production supervisor

tasks.design: Use the existing station-reporting category in {OPS_SYSTEM} to capture entries and calculate draft totals. A native report layout inserts checked values; the assembler resolves discrepancies, writes the explanation and checks the exact version sent through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper or spreadsheet entries require repeated aggregation and report transcription.
tasks.enabler_now: Station records and native production-report queries can reuse the same captured fields.
tasks.still_hard: Missing counts, ambiguous waste reasons and implausible time entries need investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The assembler explains what actually happened on the line.

ambition.what: Review reliable production totals during the shift rather than reconstructing them later.

tasks.altitude: Maintain trustworthy production evidence with less aggregation and retyping.

reach.learn: Which reported differences reflect actual process problems

evidence.claim: Station instruction systems can capture scanner and test results and return serial numbers to ERP systems.
Production monitoring has replaced paper reports and spreadsheets at H+H factories; the digest supplies no directly transferable time saving for this task.
The proposed labour shares and savings are unmeasured scenarios.

assumptions: Boundary includes source capture, aggregation, discrepancy resolution, narrative and an existing supervisor report send. The report is assumed to be read by the production supervisor today.

The assembler is the producer of job identifier, output quantity, start/stop times and waste reason in s1; all 25 capture hours remain. No connected sensor, pre-existing discrepancy code or cost-free structured input is assumed. Missing entries are reconstructed manually in s3.
The supervisor's existing counting definitions and reporting period are selected within s1. No new automated ERP send, alert or record commit is implied by the draft query.

Native station records and report layouts precede custom integration. The query removes 30 hours of manual aggregation; populated report fields remove 12 of 20 transcription hours while retaining eight hours for explanation and correction.
The author's ordinary saves are included in retained entry and report work without a separate approval. The gate concerns the real supervisor send only.
unknowns: Whether the present system already calculates the report
How much narrative production supervisors actually require
research_questions: Can a shift trial reconcile all queried totals to retained station entries?
How many report preparation minutes are aggregation versus explanatory writing?

already_counted.description: Capture and validation of every reporting field remain in s1 and discrepancy review in s3.

incremental.description: Assembler checks the reporting configuration after job or reason-list changes.
Production supervisor maintains counting definitions and reviews report-layout changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact report period, job scope, totals, explanation, attachment version and supervisor recipient checked immediately before sending; edits invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100, R=58 (capture25+review20+explanation8+send5), gross42 less focal upkeep3 gives net39. Low20 retains 15 aggregation hours for legacy jobs and 12 explanation hours because current fields do not match the report: R77, less3 upkeep. High32 retains five aggregation hours and ten explanation hours for mixed layouts: R65, less3 upkeep. Central case requires full field and definition compatibility; these are distinct compatibility cases, not a shared benefit multiplier.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Instruct customers in product installation and maintenance

steps.what: Find the applicable product installation, repair and maintenance instructions
Check product condition, customer experience and safe instructional scope
Instruct customers using the checked product procedures
Demonstrate the maintenance actions and check the customer's understanding

tasks.design: Configure a product-and-revision manual index in {DOCS} to shorten instruction lookup. The assembler checks applicability and gives the instruction and demonstration personally; no new customer training record is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct procedure can require searching several manual files.
tasks.enabler_now: An existing document library can expose product, revision and procedure headings in one view.
tasks.still_hard: The customer's skill and the actual product condition determine what can safely be taught.
tasks.human_edge: The assembler adapts the explanation and watches the customer attempt the action.
tasks.altitude: Arrive at the right approved procedure faster while retaining customer teaching.

reach.learn: Which manual sections repeatedly require clarification

evidence.claim: A native document-library index may shorten manual retrieval; its benefit here is unmeasured.

assumptions: The task covers reference retrieval, suitability judgement, instruction and demonstration. No completion log, certificate or written customer follow-up is assumed to exist today.

The assembler obtains product identifier and customer question during s1; the manual owner supplies approved product and revision metadata through existing document control. Checking those fields and resolving unknown revisions remains in s1. Missing metadata means manual search with no saving.
Native document views precede AI answers. The index removes 4.5 of 15 lookup hours by eliminating cross-file browsing, with 10.5 hours retained for reading and matching procedures.
The send gates are the instructor's immediate checks of the actual spoken explanation and demonstration. They are not approval stages for author saves.
unknowns: Whether procedure headings and revisions are already searchable together
research_questions: Can staff find the applicable procedure faster on a sample of real customer questions without selecting an obsolete revision?

already_counted.description: Product and revision checks and manual reading remain in s1.

incremental.description: Assembler reports broken index references during ordinary use.

approvals.approved_version: Actual product-specific explanation and answer, checked against the current procedure and safe teaching scope before each statement; new questions require a renewed check.
Actual demonstration action, product condition and safety precautions checked immediately before performance; changed conditions invalidate the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario: B=100, R=95.5, gross4.5 less focal upkeep0.5 gives net4. Low0 if missing revision metadata forces the current manual search and no index is adopted, retaining all work with no added upkeep. High2.5 retains12 of15 lookup hours because procedure headings only partly match customer language, plus all85 teaching and judgement hours, less0.5 upkeep. Central retains10.5 lookup hours with well-indexed headings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain safe assembly and customer instruction while reducing reporting and reference navigation.
reach: Technical support maintaining usable manual references
role.ambitious_version: An assembler who provides dependable production evidence and clear product guidance without repeated report transcription.
